lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, positioned in the spaces between vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity run dorso-ventrally across the flank, aligning with the columns of circular blobs to create a geometric grid pattern across the mid-section of the organism.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible running along the longitudinal axis of the flank; each ridge displays a high-contrast luminance gradient with light pixels on the superior edge and dark pixels (shadowing) on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately twelve elongated, silver-toned objects exhibiting independent locomotion is localized near the ventral-posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
